title: Cortex Agent Vendor Skill Manifest
description: Provenance + governance metadata for an externally-sourced (third-party) skill vendored into .agent/global-shared-skills/. Required for every vendor skill; consumed by _schema/validate.js.

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier matching the directory name under global-shared-skills/.

display_name.description: Human-friendly label; if absent, falls back to name.

version.description: Upstream semver or release tag (e.g. 'v1.0.0' or 'v2.0.0-beta.3').

source.description: Provenance — where the upstream code came from.

ref.description: Pinned commit SHA (40 hex) or branch/tag (e.g. 'v1.0.0' or 'main').

resolved_sha.description: Concrete commit SHA at the time of last sync. Pinned and used for upgrade detection.

path.description: Path within the upstream repo where the skill lives, e.g. 'skills/brainstorming' or 'CLAUDE.md'.

url.description: Direct link to upstream README or source file (optional).

synced_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last upstream sync.

compatibility.description: Cortex-Agent ecosystem compatibility — which agents/harnesses it works with.

cortex_agent.description: Minimum cortex-agent version supporting this skill (semver range).

skill_standard.description: Skill standard the manifest conforms to.

skill_files.description: Top-level entrypoint files (relative to the vendor/<name>/ directory).

notes.description: Any quirks, known limitations, or cortex-agent-specific overrides (Markdown-friendly).

checksum.description: Optional integrity checksums per vendored file (sha256).
